title: Apple earnings: Tim Cook is heading out on top as stock surges to lead the Mag 7 in 2026
byline: Ben Shimkus, William Edwards, Max Adams
excerpt: Apple will report earnings after the closing bell on Thursday. As Tim Cook prepares to step down as CEO, AAPL stock leads the Magnificent 7 in 2026.
content_html:
Live Updated 2026-07-30T18:23:49.154Z

Read in app

Apple's fiscal third-quarter results are Tim Cook's last as CEO, and he's going out on a high note.

As the rest of the Magnificent Seven companies struggle with questions about what all of their AI capex is actually for, Apple has largely sidestepped the debate this year by focusing on their core offerings: consumer hardware.

The stock is the best performer in the elite group of mega-cap tech names this year, up 25%. The company topped a $5 trillion market cap for the first time earlier this week before falling slightly.

Apple's outlook has some challenges, though.

Cook said earlier this year that Apple was raising prices to offset the supply crunch in memory hardware, and the move could impact demand for new devices. The iPhone was left out of Apple's recent price hikes, but Apple is widely expected to boost prices in September with the new lineup as it faces cost pressures on its famously high gross margin. The company could provide signal on possible iPhone price hikes on the earnings call.

Investors are also going to want to hear at least some update about the company's AI plans, even though Apple is not quite a capex story like other tech giants.

Apple will publish its results around 4:30 p.m. ET after the closing bell. The call with analysts will begin around 5 p.m. ET.

Copied!

You can now lease your iPhone like a car

Earlier this week, the company launched a new program called Apple Upgrade in partnership with Klarna that allows shoppers to lease iPhones, Watches, Macs, and iPads. It acts like a car lease, but for new tech, and offers lower monthly payments than financing a new iPhone.

A base iPhone 17e leased through Apple Upgrade is $17.99 a month, while financing the same phone costs $24.95 a month.

A base iPhone 17e leased through Apple Upgrade is $17.99 a month, while financing the same phone costs $24.95 a month.

At the end of the term, customers can return the device, trade it in for a newer model, or pay the remaining balance to keep it.

Copied!

Goldman eyes services-fueled growth for years

Goldman expects Apple to post 18% year-over-year revenue growth, beating Wall Street's 15% estimate, thanks in part to strong iPhone and Mac sales. The bank sees an earnings beat of $1.93 per share compared to the $1.89 consensus.

Goldman has a "Buy" rating on the stock, and said they expect the company's services offerings like iCloud+ and AppleCare+ to be a leading driver of its growth going forward.

Goldman has a "Buy" rating on the stock, and said they expect the company's services offerings like iCloud+ and AppleCare+ to be a leading driver of its growth going forward.

"The majority of gross profit growth over the next 5-years should be driven by Services, which should mark an inflection point in the Services investment narrative and support AAPL's premium multiple," Michael Ng, an analyst at the bank, said in a July 27 note.

The bank's price target for the stock is $370 a share.

Copied!

Earnings arrive shortly after price hikes

Apple increased prices across its Mac and iPad lineups on June 25, but has — so far — spared the iPhone from similar hikes. Analysts expect the tech company to raise the phone's prices during the September launch of the iPhone 18. CEO Tim Cook or CFO Kevan Parekh might field questions on potential iPhone price hikes on the analyst call.

Analysts expect the tech company to raise the phone's prices during the September launch of the iPhone 18. CEO Tim Cook or CFO Kevan Parekh might field questions on potential iPhone price hikes on the analyst call.

The increases stem from a memory crunch that's making it harder to build tech hardware.

Those price hikes will have a negligible impact on this quarter's earnings. Thursday's call only covers until June 30. But moving forward, that will likely drive up the average sale price of its hardware.

Still, we're keeping an eye on how Apple sells these price hikes to investors.

Copied!

Apple's memory crunch

The tech industry is racing to secure memory chips — and the squeeze is driving up Apple's costs.

AI data centers are consuming enormous quantities of high-end memory, prompting chipmakers to devote more of their production capacity to the booming market. That has tightened supplies and raised prices for the memory and storage chips used in consumer devices such as iPhones, Macs, and iPads.

The tech industry is racing to secure memory chips — and the squeeze is driving up Apple's costs.

AI data centers are consuming enormous quantities of high-end memory, prompting chipmakers to devote more of their production capacity to the booming market. That has tightened supplies and raised prices for the memory and storage chips used in consumer devices such as iPhones, Macs, and iPads.

Tim Cook has likened that upheaval to a "100-year flood."

As those components become more expensive, Apple has begun passing some of the costs on to shoppers — a move the company rarely makes. In late June, Apple raised prices across much of its Mac and iPad lineups, with increases ranging from roughly $100 to more than $1,000 on certain models and configurations.

Apple is scheduled to release the iPhone 18 in September. Analysts predict it will carry higher prices than the current model.

Copied!

AI strategy still in question, Morningstar says

Dave Sekera, Morningstar's chief US market strategist, said in an email that Apple would be the "least interesting" of all the mega-cap firms this earnings season, as they've largely stayed out of the AI conversation.

He said the main questions around the firm would be how they can offset rising memory costs, and whether their higher iPhone 18 prices will cause a spike in buying of the iPhone 17.

Dave Sekera, Morningstar's chief US market strategist, said in an email that Apple would be the "least interesting" of all the mega-cap firms this earnings season, as they've largely stayed out of the AI conversation.

He said the main questions around the firm would be how they can offset rising memory costs, and whether their higher iPhone 18 prices will cause a spike in buying of the iPhone 17.

But Sekera still wants to hear from the company on its AI strategy.

"With Apple, I think we need a better discussion of what they think AI use cases are going to be," he said. "Apple has steered clear of capex spending on the AI buildout boom, which I think will probably serve them well over the longer term, but for now, we're still not really understanding Apple's killer case for AI that will drive a lot of new economic value for individual users."

Copied!

Jefferies is cautious ahead of results

Jefferies thinks Apple's stock has downside over the next 12 months, with its base-case price target of $308.92 a share, implying about 10% downside.

The bank said it expects Apple to have missed on gross margins last quarter, and that memory costs are going to be a problem for margins going forward.

"Although AAPL's premium iPhone roadmap and ability to raise prices would partly offset higher memory costs, margin is on the downside," said Edison Lee, an analyst, in a July 27 client note.

blocks.html_en: "The majority of gross profit growth over the next 5-years should be driven by Services, which should mark an inflection point in the Services investment narrative and support AAPL's premium multiple," Michael Ng, an analyst at the bank, said in a July 27 note.

blocks.html_en: AI data centers are consuming enormous quantities of high-end memory, prompting chipmakers to devote more of their production capacity to the booming market. 苹果第三财季业绩是蒂姆·库克担任首席执行官的最后一个季度，他的表现非常出色。

当七大公司的其他公司都在苦苦思索其所有人工智能资本支出的实际用途时，苹果公司今年通过专注于其核心产品：消费硬件，基本上回避了争论。

该股是今年大型科技股精英股中表现最好的股票，上涨了 25%。 该公司本周早些时候市值首次突破 5 万亿美元，随后略有下跌。

不过，苹果的前景面临一些挑战。

库克今年早些时候表示，苹果正在提高价格，以抵消内存硬件的供应紧缩，此举可能会影响新设备的需求。 iPhone 被排除在苹果最近的涨价行动之外，但人们普遍预计苹果将在 9 月份通过新产品线提高价格，因为其毛利率高而面临成本压力。 该公司可能会在财报电话会议上就 iPhone 价格可能上涨提供信号。

投资者也希望至少听到有关该公司人工智能计划的一些最新消息，尽管苹果不像其他科技巨头那样有资本支出故事。

您现在可以像租赁汽车一样租赁 iPhone

本周早些时候，该公司与 Klarna 合作推出了一项名为 Apple Upgrade 的新计划，允许购物者租赁 iPhone、手表、Mac 和 iPad。 它的作用类似于汽车租赁，但针对的是新技术，并且每月支付的费用比购买新 iPhone 的费用要低。

通过 Apple Upgrade 租赁的基础款 iPhone 17e 的价格为每月 17.99 美元，而同一部手机的融资费用为每月 24.95 美元。

高盛多年来着眼于服务业推动增长

高盛预计苹果公司的收入将同比增长 18%，超过华尔街 15% 的预期，部分原因是 iPhone 和 Mac 销售强劲。 该银行预计每股收益将高于 1.93 美元，而市场普遍预期为 1.89 美元。

高盛对该股给予“买入”评级，并表示预计该公司的 iCloud+ 和 AppleCare+ 等服务产品将成为其未来增长的主要推动力。

高盛对该股给予“买入”评级，并表示预计该公司的 iCloud+ 和 AppleCare+ 等服务产品将成为其未来增长的主要推动力。

该银行分析师 Michael Ng 在 7 月 27 日的一份报告中表示：“未来 5 年的大部分毛利润增长应由服务业推动，这应标志着服务业投资叙述的拐点，并支持 AAPL 的溢价市盈率。”

该银行对该股的目标价为每股 370 美元。

价格上涨后不久就公布了盈利

苹果公司于 6 月 25 日提高了 Mac 和 iPad 系列产品的价格，但到目前为止，iPhone 并未出现类似的涨价。 分析师预计，这家科技公司将在 9 月份推出 iPhone 18 期间提高手机的价格。 首席执行官蒂姆·库克或首席财务官凯文·帕里克可能会在分析师电话会议上回答有关 iPhone 价格潜在上涨的问题。

这种增长源于内存短缺，这使得构建技术硬件变得更加困难。

这些价格上涨对本季度收益的影响可以忽略不计。 周四的电话会议只持续到 6 月 30 日。 但展望未来，这可能会推高其硬件的平均售价。

尽管如此，我们仍在关注苹果如何向投资者推销这些涨价的消息。

苹果的内存不足

科技行业正在竞相争夺存储芯片，而这种挤压正在推高苹果的成本。

人工智能数据中心正在消耗大量高端内存，促使芯片制造商将更多产能投入到蓬勃发展的市场。 这导致 iPhone、Mac 和 iPad 等消费设备中使用的内存和存储芯片的供应紧张并提高了价格。

蒂姆·库克将这次剧变比作“百年一遇的洪水”。

随着这些组件变得更加昂贵，苹果已经开始将部分成本转嫁给消费者——该公司很少采取这种举措。 6 月下旬，苹果提高了大部分 Mac 和 iPad 系列产品的价格，某些型号和配置的涨幅从大约 100 美元到超过 1,000 美元不等。

苹果计划于 9 月发布 iPhone 18。 分析师预测它将比当前型号的价格更高。

晨星表示，人工智能战略仍存在疑问

晨星公司首席美国市场策略师戴夫·塞克拉(Dave Sekera)在一封电子邮件中表示，苹果将成为本财报季所有大型公司中“最不感兴趣”的公司，因为它们基本上没有参与人工智能的讨论。

他表示，该公司面临的主要问题是如何抵消不断上涨的内存成本，以及 iPhone 18 价格上涨是否会导致 iPhone 17 的购买量激增。

晨星公司首席美国市场策略师戴夫·塞克拉(Dave Sekera)在一封电子邮件中表示，苹果将成为本财报季所有大型公司中“最不感兴趣”的公司，因为它们基本上没有参与人工智能的讨论。

他表示，该公司面临的主要问题是如何抵消不断上涨的内存成本，以及 iPhone 18 价格上涨是否会导致 iPhone 17 的购买量激增。

但 Sekera 仍然希望听取该公司关于其人工智能战略的意见。

“对于苹果，我认为我们需要更好地讨论他们认为的人工智能用例将会是什么，”他说。 “苹果公司已经避开了人工智能建设热潮上的资本支出，我认为从长远来看，这可能会给他们带来好处，但目前，我们仍然没有真正理解苹果公司的人工智能杀手级案例，这将为个人用户带来大量新的经济价值。”

杰富瑞 (Jefferies) 认为苹果股价在未来 12 个月内将出现下跌，其基本目标股价为每股 308.92 美元，意味着下跌约 10%。

该银行表示，预计苹果上季度的毛利率将出现下滑，并且内存成本将成为影响未来利润率的问题。
